Design review found that TikTok ignores targeting fields that do not match the targeting mode without an error, so each mode has its own allowlist and other fields are refused instead of being dropped silently.

The targeting checks, projection and owned-audience rule were moved out of the saved audience module into src/tiktok-targeting.ts so both families share them; the saved audience tests were rerun and pass unchanged.
limitations: Synthetic validation only; no live provider credentials, reads or account mutations in this batch.
Targeting IDs, attribution window combinations per objective and minimum budgets are validated by TikTok, not in review.
Referenced audiences must be owned by the advertiser; shared audiences are refused even where TikTok would accept them. Shared pixels are allowed and reported.
Smart+ ads, ad group edits, and app, lead generation, catalog, search, value-based, deep funnel, zip code and Pangle package ad groups stay unqualified.
